text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah~, what a drag... Unbelievable~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Are you here to view the 
"Masterpieces of German Art Exhibition" as 
well, Jordan-san?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's homework. Gotta see it and write 
a report. But I don't get art stuff at 
all. Such a pain~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we tour it together? I 
possess some knowledge regarding German 
art.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what is this...? Why are these two 
standing so far apart?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is a painting depicting lovers. The 
man is the painter himself, and his 
partner is a noblewoman.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Isn't the distance kinda far for 
that, though? Ah, like a "rough patch" 
kind of thing!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A rough patch... Fufu, what an interesting 
interpretation! Since they were lovers of 
differing social status, they kept their 
distance to avoid suspicion regarding 
their relationship.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Isn't that messed up!? They're into 
each other, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that era, relationships across social 
classes were strictly prohibited. In the 
end, these two were never united either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's so sad! They'd get in trouble 
if caught? Then couldn't they just DM each 
other? On Umastagram or whatever! Then 
they could flirt without getting caught, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose such methods of 
communication do exist today. Hmm, viewing 
it as a modern love letter, I see your 
point...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... right, no Umasta back then. Ah, my 
bad, I really don't get this stuff at all. 
Ahaha~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not the case. You possess a 
wonderful sensibility, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the distance between the lovers 
in the painting, empathizing with their 
feelings... and your perspective on modern 
Japanese romance was quite intriguing as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to cherish that 
down-to-earth and lovely sensibility of 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh... really...? Th-Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, Flash-san, you're a literal GOD! I 
can totally nail this report now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to have been of help. ...By the 
way, Jordan-san, you have been walking 
tilted approximately five degrees to the 
left for some time now...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about specific! Nah, just got a 
bit of shoe blister, y'know? Just bought 
these today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies for not noticing sooner. Let 
us treat it at that bench over there. I 
carry a first-aid kit with me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, I'm totally fine! It's really 
no big deal...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it would be troublesome if it 
worsens. If walking causes you pain, 
please take my arm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!? No, no, no! A-All right...! I'll... 
I'll walk under my own power!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! Putting a handkerchief on the 
bench...!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It would not do for your clothing to be 
soiled, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, pardon me while I attend to your 
foot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!? F-Flash-san! Stop! Stop! You don't 
gotta kneel down...! Gaaah, what even is 
this...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uhm... that was fun. Thanks. Even if... I 
caused you a ton of trouble...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's the first time I learned that 
side of you, Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...? "That side of me"... meaning...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... nah... Let's hang out again 
sometime. ...Later!

While walking through the academy, I 
spotted Eishin Flash lost deep in thought.
choice_data_list: What's the matter? Something on your mind?

What's wrong? Are you troubled by 
something?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... thank you for your concern. Well, 
rather than a problem, to tell the truth—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I found myself unable to gauge 
the true meaning behind her words.

Her friend must have learned a new side of 
her and felt they became closer. When I 
explained that to her—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Learning a side of me... and becoming 
closer... So that was it. I see...

Wearing a puzzled expression, Eishin Flash 
remained lost in thought.
